itens.texto:
O Japão investirá até US$ 21 bilhões em duas fábricas de chips no estado de Nova York, que serão de propriedade conjunta do governo norte-americano e de interesses japoneses e operadas pela GlobalFoundries , disse a empresa nesta quarta-feira.
As ações da empresa sediada em Malta e Nova York subiram mais de 4% no início do pregão. Elas acumulam alta de mais de 33% neste ano.
A medida faz parte de um acordo firmado no ano passado pelo governo do presidente Donald Trump para que o Japão invista US$ 550 bilhões nos EUA, em troca da redução das tarifas americanas sobre carros japoneses e outras importações de pelo menos 25% para 15%.
— Com informações de Reuters

itens.titulo: Altcoins slip as bitcoin (BTC) price steadies before U.S. CPI report: Crypto Markets Today
itens.descricao: Altcoins slip as bitcoin (BTC) price steadies before U.S. CPI report: Crypto Markets Today CoinDesk
trechos: Bitcoin holds above $83,000 ahead of U.S.
inflation data as altcoins lag Bitcoin briefly reached $84,000 before easing back, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 0.6% since midnight as traders waited for U.S.
- Bitcoin traded around $83,450 after spiking to $84,000 early in the European morning.
- The CoinDesk 80 fell 0.6% since midnight UTC while the CoinDesk 20 edged higher, with DeFi tokens the weakest sector.
CPI, expected to show inflation quickening to 3.6%, after New York Fed President John Williams said he saw no need for rate increases in 2027.
Bitcoin  was trading around $83,450 in the European morning after briefly spiking to $84,000 at 08:00 UTC, having bounced from a low of $80,970 on Tuesday.
Altcoins struggled to follow, with the CoinDesk 80 falling 0.6% since midnight UTC while the CoinDesk 20 added 0.2%, leaving close to two-thirds of the CoinDesk 100’s members lower.
CoinMarketCap’s Altcoin Season index slipped to 55 from 60 a week ago.
